records.name: Swarnim Gujarat Sports University
records.description: Swarnim Gujarat Sports University (SGSU) in Gandhinagar is one of India's few dedicated sports universities, established by the Government of Gujarat, offering programs in sports sciences, sports coaching, sports management, and yoga. The university has excellent sports infrastructure and collaborates with Sports Authority of India and Gujarat's Olympic development program. SGSU graduates serve in Gujarat's school sports programs, state sports academies, and corporate wellness roles.

records.name: Tamil Nadu Physical Education and Sports University
records.description: Tamil Nadu Physical Education and Sports University (TNPESU) in Chennai is a specialized state university for physical education and sports sciences, offering programs in physical education, sports management, yoga, and coaching. It provides degree programs for physical education teachers serving Tamil Nadu's schools and trains coaches for state-level sports programs. TNPESU plays a key role in developing Tamil Nadu's sports talent pipeline and producing physical education professionals.

records.name: Guru Nanak Dev University
records.description: Guru Nanak Dev University (GNDU) in Amritsar is a leading state university in Punjab, established in 1969 to commemorate the 500th birth anniversary of Guru Nanak Dev Ji, offering programs across arts, sciences, engineering, commerce, and sports sciences. The university is known for its Punjab history, music, and sports programs, and its Department of Sports Sciences and Physical Education has produced national and international athletes. GNDU hosts extensive sports facilities and contributes significantly to Punjabi language and Sikh studies scholarship.

records.name: K11 Fitness Academy
records.description: K11 Fitness Academy in Mumbai is one of India's leading fitness education institutions offering internationally recognized personal training certifications including NASM (National Academy of Sports Medicine) licensed programs. It has trained thousands of fitness professionals who work as personal trainers, group exercise instructors, and gym managers across India and internationally. K11 is known for its rigorous curriculum, practical assessments, and strong placement support in the growing Indian fitness industry.

records.name: ACFIT Academy (NASM India Partner)
records.description: ACFIT Academy in Mumbai is India's authorized partner for NASM (National Academy of Sports Medicine) certifications, offering courses in personal training, corrective exercise, performance enhancement, and nutrition coaching. The academy provides both in-person and online certification programs following NASM's globally recognized curriculum. ACFIT-trained professionals are employed by premium gyms, corporate fitness centers, and sports performance organizations across India.

records.name: Integrated Fitness and Sports Institute (IFSI)
records.description: Integrated Fitness and Sports Institute (IFSI) in Mumbai offers comprehensive fitness education programs including personal training, sports nutrition, and strength and conditioning certifications. IFSI provides internationally aligned curricula and practical training in well-equipped fitness labs, preparing graduates for careers in fitness centers, sports clubs, and rehabilitation facilities. The institute caters to students from Mumbai's active fitness community and aspiring fitness entrepreneurs.

records.name: Classic Fitness Academy
records.description: Classic Fitness Academy in Mumbai is a fitness education institution offering certificate and diploma programs in personal training, group fitness instruction, yoga, and sports nutrition. It offers both international certifications (ISSA, ACE) and Indian Board of Fitness certifications, making it a one-stop destination for fitness career aspirants in Mumbai. The academy has a strong alumni network working across premium fitness chains, sports complexes, and hospital wellness centers.

records.name: International Institute of Fitness Excellence and Management (IIFEM)
records.description: International Institute of Fitness Excellence and Management (IIFEM) in New Delhi is a fitness education institution offering certificate and diploma programs in personal training, sports nutrition, yoga, and wellness coaching. It provides international certification programs (ISSA, ACE, NASM) and has trained thousands of fitness professionals serving gyms, corporate wellness centers, and sports clubs. IIFEM operates across India and has an online learning platform serving students from smaller cities.

records.name: Frankfinn Institute of Air Hostess Training
records.description: Frankfinn Institute of Air Hostess Training is India's leading aviation training institution with over 35 centers across the country, offering certificate programs in air hostess training, hospitality, travel, and customer service. Established in 1993, it has trained over 100,000 students who work as cabin crew with Indian and international airlines, in hotel hospitality roles, and in customer-facing corporate jobs. Frankfinn is recognized by IATA and its training programs are aligned with airline grooming and customer service standards.

records.name: Avalon Aviation Academy
records.description: Avalon Aviation Academy in Mumbai is a DGCA-approved flying training organization offering Commercial Pilot License (CPL) training and type rating programs for aspiring commercial pilots. The academy provides training on Cessna and Diamond aircraft and offers integrated and modular CPL programs designed to meet DGCA requirements. Avalon has placed graduates as first officers at major Indian airlines and has partnerships with regional carriers for streamlined placement.
